text_block_list.text:
Unable to focus, my work wasn't making any progress.
So I came to the park to take a breather...
(Whizzzz―――)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Look ouuuuttt!!
(Smack!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew~, made it in time~.
Sorry for startling you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I was playing baseball with the kids,
and the batted ball flew all the way over here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wait, you didn't even notice?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then that was seriously a close call.
Pheeew~~, so glad you're not hurt~.

My attention seems completely scattered.
I'd like to get back in the groove somehow, but――

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hey, are you alright?
You look kinda down, nano.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know!
Why don't you play baseball with us!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hit, run, and feel totally refreshed!
I bet you'll feel super clear-headed, nano!
choice_data_list: I still have work left to do...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hit, run, and feel totally refreshed!
I bet you'll feel super clear-headed, nano!
choice_data_list: I still have work left to do...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then before baseball...
Here, have a nutrient-packed Toughness Bar, nano!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I always recharge my energy with this!
You'll be full of energy for sure!

It was quite filling and delicious...!
Combined with her kindness, I felt energy welling up!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looks like you've perked right up!
All hail the Toughness Bar, nano!
(Grumble~~)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: Maybe you should eat something too
You should probably eat something too

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ turns out the one I gave you
was my last one...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
B-But don't worry about me!
Seeing you get energized makes me way happier!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I have tons more back in my room!
I'll eat a whole bunch when I get back♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yup!
Alright then, play ball!!

Afterwards, having fun playing baseball with Ines Fujin
and the kids gave me a great change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Work sounds really tough. When my part-time job
was super packed, it took a lot out of me too, nano...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, I know!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Go, go, big brother!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Go, go, big sister!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Fight on, gambareee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I was overwhelmed with training and part-time work,
my little sisters would always cheer me on like that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Cheering with all your body like that with all your might!
It made me so happy~~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It was super reassuring and encouraging.
So I can guarantee its effectiveness!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But... maybe it was a bit childish.
Ugh, now I'm getting embarrassed...!
choice_data_list: It was both super effective and cute!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Jeez, don't tease me like that~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
M-More importantly, here...! 
We've gotta inject some fight into your body too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's my personal favorite!
Drink this and do your best at work!

Thanks to her warm cheers and the sports drink,
I was able to power through my work!
